guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以水分蒸發、熱回收與乾燥系統邊界為主線，從濕乾基分辨、蒸發水量、汽化潛熱、進料與產品顯熱進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops evaporation, heat recovery and dryer system boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with wet and dry bases, evaporated-water balance, latent-heat requirement, feed and product sensible heat. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「濕乾基分辨」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「蒸發水量」的觀測點。由進料、產品及冷凝水重量重建水分收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「汽化潛熱」的觀測點。比較水量收支與燃料／蒸汽能量表，列出未回收熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「進料與產品顯熱」的觀測點。對照進出口溫度、質量及熱媒供應量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「熱回收溫位」的觀測點。畫出冷熱物流溫度區間，確認回收熱仍有可用溫差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「單位蒸發能耗」的觀測點。同時計量水分移除與外購、回收熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「預脫水的熱效益」的觀測點。由進料、產品及冷凝水重量重建水分收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「沼氣熱值邊界」的觀測點。使用氣體分析器與標準化流量計配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「凝結水與尾氣」的觀測點。量冷凝水並以露點儀確認乾燥器出口。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「能源、品質與防護交接」的觀測點。用分表列出每一輔機與可用餘熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet and dry bases. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for evaporated-water balance. Rebuild the water balance from feed, product and condensate masses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for latent-heat requirement. Compare water balance with fuel/steam energy and list unrecovered heat. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed and product sensible heat. Compare inlet/outlet temperatures, mass and heating-medium supply. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for heat-recovery temperature grade. Plot hot/cold temperature ranges and check usable driving temperature difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for energy per water evaporated. Meter water removal and imported/recovered heat simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for thermal benefit of pre-dewatering. Rebuild the water balance from feed, product and condensate masses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biogas heating-value basis. Pair gas composition with normalized volumetric flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for condensate and exhaust. Measure condensate and check dryer outlet with a dew-point instrument. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for energy, quality and protection handoff. Submeter each auxiliary and report usable waste heat separately. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 把濕基含水率直接當乾基含水比。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
未列粉塵與揮發損失就宣稱固體全守恆。診斷與介入：先由乾固體收支確認需去除水量，再比較熱負荷。
只算顯熱會大幅漏掉乾燥熱需求。診斷與介入：另加顯熱與熱損，避免潛熱單項被當總能源。
把所有物質熱容當水且不揭露假設。診斷與介入：更新進料量、含水率和溫度，再核對熱損及回收。
回收熱重複抵扣兩個單元。診斷與介入：核對熱源與熱需求溫位，避免把低溫回熱全算可用。
以每噸濕污泥比較不同含水率。診斷與介入：同步量實際蒸發水及整套熱輸入，核對相同邊界。
只看乾燥機而漏掉前段改善。診斷與介入：先由乾固體收支確認需去除水量，再比較熱負荷。
濕氣量未校正即估熱值。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
把蒸發當作污染物全部消除。診斷與介入：另測露點與含濕，檢查排水及下游相容性。
只提高乾度卻忽略產品粉塵與系統能耗。診斷與介入：核對每個附屬電表與能源邊界，分列熱能和電能。
pitfallsEn: Wet-basis moisture is mistaken for dry-basis moisture ratio. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
Ignoring dust/volatile losses overstates exact solids conservation. Diagnostic response: Confirm water removal through the dry-solids balance before comparing heat demand.
Sensible heat alone misses much of drying demand. Diagnostic response: Add sensible heat and losses rather than treating latent heat as total energy.
Assuming every heat capacity equals water without disclosure is misleading. Diagnostic response: Update feed, moisture and temperature and check heat loss/recovery.
Crediting the same recovered heat twice exaggerates savings. Diagnostic response: Check source/demand temperature grades before counting recovered heat as usable.
Per-wet-tonne comparisons across different moisture contents mislead. Diagnostic response: Measure actual evaporation and whole-system heat input at the same boundary.
A dryer-only view misses upstream improvement. Diagnostic response: Confirm water removal through the dry-solids balance before comparing heat demand.
Uncorrected wet-gas volume distorts energy. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.
Evaporation is incorrectly equated with pollutant destruction. Diagnostic response: Measure dew point/moisture separately and check drainage/downstream compatibility.
Maximizing dryness overlooks dust and total energy. Diagnostic response: Check auxiliary meters/energy boundaries and separate heat from electricity.

history.title: 污泥乾燥與熱回收
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以水分蒸發、熱回收與乾燥系統邊界為主線，從濕乾基分辨、蒸發水量、汽化潛熱、進料與產品顯熱進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops evaporation, heat recovery and dryer system boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with wet and dry bases, evaporated-water balance, latent-heat requirement, feed and product sensible heat. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
